sloka: तं धर्मे ऽग्निषु पुत्रेषु शिवं पृष्ट्वा च पार्थिवम् ।पुलस्त्योवाच राजानं हैहयानां तथा ऽर्जुनम् ।। ७.३३.१३ ॥
transliteration: taṁ dharme 'gniṣu putreṣu śivaṁ pṛṣṭvā ca pārthivam ।pulastyovāca rājānaṁ haihayānāṁ tathā 'rjunam ।। 7.33.13 ॥

translations.english: Having inquired about the welfare of that king, Kartavirya Arjuna, regarding his dharma, sacred fires, and sons, sage Pulastya then spoke to him.
